word_sets.name: Set 5 · Being sure
words: لا يمكن أن يكون / مستحيل يكون

sentences: The battery must be dead — the screen is completely black.
لا بد أن شحن البطارية قد نفد — الشاشة سوداء تمامًا.
That can't be Mona's phone. Hers is white.
لا يمكن أن يكون هذا هاتف منى. هاتفها أبيض.
The Wi-Fi might be down. Let's restart the router.
ربما يكون الواي فاي مقطوعًا. لنُعِد تشغيل الراوتر.
You must be tired after working on the computer all day.
لا بد أنك متعب بعد العمل على الحاسوب طوال اليوم.
Have you backed up your photos?
هل أخذت نسخة احتياطية من صورك؟
I can't log in. I think I've forgotten my password.
لا أستطيع تسجيل الدخول. أظن أنني نسيت كلمة المرور.
He isn't answering. He could be in a meeting.
إنه لا يرد. ربما يكون في اجتماع.
My laptop keeps crashing, so I need to update it.
حاسوبي يتعطّل باستمرار، لذلك أحتاج إلى تحديثه.
My son spends too much time on social media.
يقضي ابني وقتًا طويلًا جدًا على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.
It looks like the file is too big to upload.
يبدو أن الملف كبير جدًا ولا يمكن رفعه.

grammar.intro_en:
must = I'm sure it's true · can't = I'm sure it's NOT true · might / could / may = it's possibly true.
modal + be: He must be tired. · modal + be + -ing (now): She might be driving.
grammar.intro_ar: عندما تستنتج شيئًا من الدليل الذي أمامك: «أكيد / لا بد» = must، و«مستحيل يكون» = can't، و«ربما» = might / could / may. الخطأ الشائع أن يقول المتعلم ✗ He mustn't be at home للمعنى «مستحيل يكون في البيت»؛ لكن mustn't معناها «ممنوع». الصحيح: ✓ He can't be at home. ولا تضع to بعد must: ✗ It must to be expensive.

rows: The lights are on. They must be at home.
He isn't answering. He might be asleep.
That can't be Ali. He's in Aswan this week.

notes: ✗ He mustn't be at home — the lights are off. ✓ He can't be at home.
✗ It must to be new. ✓ It must be new.
For actions happening now use be + -ing: Listen! She must be practising the piano.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 · Complete with must, might or can't.
exercises.instructions: Complete with must, might or can't.
items: 1) I'm not sure where Nour is. She ___ be at the gym.
2) He's been working for twelve hours. He ___ be exhausted.
3) You've just eaten a big lunch. You ___ be hungry again!
4) That ___ be Omar — he's in Aswan this week.
5) Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.
6) This phone costs 60,000 pounds! It ___ be the newest model.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 · Rewrite the sentences with must, might or can't.
exercises.instructions: Rewrite the sentences with must, might or can't.
items: 1) I'm sure he is at home.
2) It's possible that the shop is closed.
3) I'm sure this isn't your bag.
4) Maybe she is working late.
5) I'm sure they are watching the match.
answers: 2) The shop might / could / may be closed.
4) She might / could / may be working late.
5) They must be watching the match.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 · Match 1–5 with a–e. a) It can't be new. b) He might be asleep. c) The battery must be dead. d) It might be out of paper. e) The internet must be down.
exercises.instructions: Match 1–5 with a–e. a) It can't be new. b) He might be asleep. c) The battery must be dead. d) It might be out of paper. e) The internet must be down.
items: 1) My phone won't turn on.
2) No websites will open.
3) Ali isn't answering his phone.
4) This laptop is only 3,000 pounds.
5) The printer isn't working.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 · Translate into English.
items: 1) لا بد أنها في العمل.
2) لا يمكن أن يكون هذا صحيحًا.
3) ربما يكون الواي فاي بطيئًا اليوم.
4) نسيت كلمة المرور الخاصة بي.
answers: 3) The Wi-Fi might / could / may be slow today.
4) I've forgotten my password. / I forgot my password.

write_speak: Write & Speak — “Technology in my life”: write 120–150 words. Which devices do you use, what problems have you had, and are you spending too much time online? Then look at three photos on your phone and say aloud what the people must, might or can't be doing.
other: Example: I use technology all day. I check my phone as soon as I wake up, and I work on a laptop from nine to five. I also use my tablet to watch videos and to have video calls with my sister, who lives in Dubai. Technology makes my life easier, but it also causes problems. Last month my laptop crashed and I lost some important files because I hadn't backed them up. Now I back up everything every Friday. Sometimes the Wi-Fi at home is very slow in the evening. It might be because everyone in the building is online at the same time. My screen time is about six hours a day, and my eyes are always tired, so I must be spending too much time in front of screens. I'm going to switch off my phone an hour before bed.
